review.assessment: This change introduces a stub implementation of `parseCsv` that immediately returns an empty array without processing any input. It leaves a TODO comment in place of the actual parsing logic, completely ignoring CSV rules like quoting, escaped double-quotes, and newline separators. Consequently, the function fails to produce any meaningful output for valid CSV strings.
